convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for TrendEnvelopes indicator and relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trading operations (open/close positions, money management, new bar detection, history loading). Custom indicator buffers require understanding of external indicator logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before trading
derived_values.used_by: BarsCalculated check and Bars_ sufficiency check

other_exits: Long position closed when DnSignal appears (with BuyPosClose permission) or when DnTrend buffer is non-zero (up-trend exits short via trend continuation logic)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values treated as fixed lot size (abs value), positive values treated as deposit fraction share. Default -0.1 means fixed 0.1 lots. Logic handled in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: TrendEnvelopes custom indicator has 4 buffers: Buffer 0=UpTrend (upper band during uptrend), Buffer 1=DnTrend (lower band during downtrend), Buffer 2=UpSignal (buy signal spike), Buffer 3=DnSignal (sell signal spike). When UpSignal is present, it signals a fresh buy entry AND closes shorts. When no UpSignal but UpTrend exists, it only closes shorts (trend continuation). Symmetric logic for sell side. SignalBar parameter (default 1) means the EA reads the signal from the previous completed bar, not the current forming bar. Recount flag forces re-evaluation if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are permission gates that can independently disable each trade direction and close action.
python_conversion_notes: The TrendEnvelopes custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it combines MA envelopes with ATR-based sensitivity to generate trend bands and entry signals. The 4-buffer structure (UpTrend, DnTrend, UpSignal, DnSignal) must be faithfully replicated. TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains all position management (open/close with SL/TP), money management (MM negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction), new bar detection (CIsNewBar class), and history loading - all must be reimplemented. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so no digit adjustment is needed. The conditional MM logic (negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit share) needs careful handling. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar for confirmation.
